label: STRICT_TOTAL_RANKING_2: TotalRanking r means that r p q holds exactly when profile q has strictly…
definition: TotalRanking r means that r p q holds exactly when profile q has strictly greater count-times-mean total than profile p. This is a stipulated ordering policy on summaries, not a morally authoritative ought or maximal feasible choice.
note: Normative authority remains open. A global ranking relation is distinguished from an attained maximum: with unbounded finite counts and fixed positive mean no greatest total is promised.
